usedFor: Clientary holds invoices, and “New Invoice” can fill a Google Docs tab via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment” in Clientary, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each payment lands in a Google Docs tab you choose, added to the text or replacing it.

watchOut: Clientary triggers here are polling, and “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace tab content, so choose add.
